data.title: US Treasury buybacks may redirect capital towards Asia

data.title: University suspends academic behind Jason Arday plagiarism charges
data.description: BRUSSELS — A Belgian university on Thursday suspended a US academic who spearheaded accusations of plagiarism against Jason Arday, the black ex-Cambridge professor found dead last week after resigning over the scandal.

data.title: 'I heard you missed me': Melania Trump jokes about month out of spotlight
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - US First Lady Melania Trump poked fun Thursday at media speculation over her month away from the public eye and scrutiny over one of President Donald Trump's close aides.

data.title: Hong Kong Tiananmen activists to receive national security verdict
data.description: HONG KONG - A Hong Kong court will deliver a verdict in the national security trial of two pro-democracy Tiananmen activists on Friday, in a case widely criticised as exemplifying the erosion of freedom of expression in the Chinese city.

data.title: UN holds second informal poll for next leader
data.description: UNITED NATIONS (UNITED STATES) - The UN's most powerful body, the Security Council, meets on Friday to hold another straw poll to gauge the popularity of a growing field of contenders to lead the embattled organisation.

data.title: Who are the candidates vying to lead the UN?

data.title: Spikers eye Olympic berth, face Australia in the opener

data.title: Panama Canal to reduce shipping over El Nino-fueled drought
data.description: PANAMA CITY - The Panama Canal will reduce shipping volumes from next month because of a drought fueled by the El Nino phenomenon, the operator of the strategic waterway linking the Atlantic and Pacific oceans said Thursday.

data.title: AI push spurs privacy fears

data.title: Govt to review gun controls
data.description: <p>The government is preparing sweeping amendments to the country's gun control law, with the draft expected to reach the cabinet around mid-September after further public consultation, Deputy Prime Minister Pakorn Nilprapunt says.</p>

data.title: DSI asks Somchart  to clarify holdings

data.title: Canva tie-up to boost sector

data.title: President Paul Biya back in Cameroon after 73 days away
data.description: YAOUNDé - President Paul Biya returned to Cameroon on Thursday after a 73-day absence that fuelled speculation about the 93-year-old's health and who is really running the country.

data.title: What a record-breaking El Nino could mean for the world
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - This year's El Nino is on track to be the strongest on record, threatening to unleash extreme weather across the globe and make 2027 the hottest recorded year by far.

data.title: US charges woman with IS-inspired plot to blow up New York State Capitol
data.description: NEW YORK - US authorities charged a woman who allegedly supported the Islamic State group with a terrorism offense Thursday after she told an FBI informant she "wanted to destroy" the New York State Capitol buildings, court filings showed.

data.title: Europe heatwaves scorch 80 million with 40 C heat: AFP analysis
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - Europe's deadly record-breaking summer heatwaves sent temperatures above 40C in areas inhabited by 80 million people from mid-June to mid-August, according to official data analysed by AFP, with many of those areas not used to such hot weather.

data.title: Vatican says 'serious concerns' over Israel-Lebanon deal implementation
data.description: VATICAN CITY - The Vatican expressed "serious concerns" Thursday about problems implementing a US-brokered deal between Israel and Lebanon, following a meeting between Pope Leo XIV and Lebanese President Joseph Aoun.

data.title: Court fines Israeli man B5,000 for threat against Koh Samui zoo owner
data.description: SURAT THANI: The Koh Samui Provincial Court ordered a 5,000-baht fine on an Israeli man for making a threat against the life of a Thai woman operating a zoo on Koh Samui.

data.title: What's behind the UAE's decision to cut Iran trade ties?
data.description: DUBAI - The UAE this week announced suspending trade with Iran, heaping pressure on its major trading partner at the same time that the US declared "economic warfare" on Tehran.

data.title: Scam fears lead Thais to miss important calls, says Whoscall
data.description: Rising concern over call centre scams is prompting many people in Thailand to reject unfamiliar phone numbers without hesitation, creating a growing risk that important calls from hospitals, banks, insurers and service providers may never reach their intended recipients.

data.title: Bangkok districts to report on pink-card probe on Friday
data.description: All 50 district offices in Bangkok are due to submit preliminary findings by Friday in a probe into pink-card registration fraud, while four City Hall officials have been suspended pending further action.

data.title: Germany reports record 14,000 heat-related deaths this summer
data.description: FRANKFURT (GERMANY) - Germany registered a record of around 14,000 heat-related deaths this summer as Europe struggled through a series of punishing heatwaves, official data showed Thursday.

data.title: Belgium's fire of the century now 'under control'
data.description: BRUSSELS (BELGIUM) - Belgium's largest wildfire in a century was brought "under control" Thursday after a seven-day fight involving hundreds of firefighters in the boggy terrain of the High Fens nature reserve.

data.title: Huge questions loom over Prince Harry's shock return to UK
data.description: LONDON - Dozens of questions have been triggered in the UK, where Prince Harry prepares to move back with his wife and children, six years after his departure sparked a bitter rift with the royal family.
